id: The Lily Shaw Quartet-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Lily Shaw Quartet
long_description:
Fresh from three years of touring worldwide with Grammy-nominated band The Teskey Brothers, saxophonist and vocalist Lily Rose Shaw will be presenting a programme of original vocal jazz compositions, joined on stage by Hector McLachlan on keys, Hikurangi Schaverien-Kaa on drums and Seth Boy on bass.

Lily's music has a strong foundation in jazz, and takes inspiration from a lifetime of eclectic musical interests, from classical to soul. Lily will be debuting new music for this special one-off, Jazz Festival performance in her hometown.

id: The Ben Wilcock Quartet-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Ben Wilcock Quartet
long_description:
Pianist Ben Wilcock is joined by Wellington Jazz heavyweights Rick Cranson on the drums and Mike Taylor on trumpet, alongside emerging bass star Lenny Hoskin. 
This new quartet brings a fresh take on the avant-garde of contemporary jazz playing material from Wilcock's recorded output, as well as selections from Monk, Mingus, Chick Corea and Frank Zappa.

Piano - Ben Wilcock
Trumpet - Mike Taylor
Drums - Rick Cranson
Bass - Lenny Hoskin

“A rare breed of pianist” - Jazz Scene UK
“At times his playing brings to mind Thelonious Monk, particularly in the faster bop tracks” - London Jazz News

id: Voyage Into The Abyssal Plain: Jake Baxendale And Friends (syd/wgtn)-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Voyage Into The Abyssal Plain: Jake Baxendale And Friends (syd/wgtn)
long_description:
Between Australia and New Zealand lies the Tasman Abyssal Plain, an immense ocean basin teeming with marine life and distinguished by exceptional geological formations: taking this mysterious environment between the two countries as inspiration, Jake Baxendale has convened a quartet of immense talent from Sydney and Wellington to plumb the depths of their shared musical experiences, which in some cases stretch back nearly 20 years.

The set will comprise original music from across the band, drawing on their collective aesthetics of pioneering 21st century jazz and improvised music from the South Pacific. 

Featuring:

Jake Baxendale - saxophones
Dan Hayles - piano
Thomas Botting - bass
Tim Geldens - drums

$15 online, $20 on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026

id: Moon Goose And Butter Wouldn't Melt-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Moon Goose And Butter Wouldn't Melt
long_description:
Join us from 7-9 for a cosy evening of music and cocktails at Bedlam & Squalor, just above Rogue and Vagabond (access on left side of building, Level 1/ 18 Garrett Street).

Starting out as humble music-making pals, Moon Goose are realising their folk powers. These strangely adorable creatures will warm your heart with their intricate harmonies, deep folk-scapes and glittering original songs. On the back of their debut EP On the Island Where Our Shadows Lie, Moon Goose have been performing to audiences across the motu, showcasing their unique blend of Celtic-inspired folk music, featuring both traditional songs from the British Isles and original compositions that celebrate nature, friendship, and the timeless spirit of folk music. Holly Dove (guitar, Celtic whistle, vocals), Britta Hamill (fiddle, vocals) and Charlie Radford (double bass, vocals) invite you to join them for an immersive musical journey rich with story and magic. Their music will move you deep and good.

Wellington-based band Butter Wouldn’t Melt bring their own unique blend of folk music incorporating aspects of country and traditional with a distinctly New Zealand flavour defined by poetic lyricism, powerful harmonies and masterful instrumentation. Gathered around one microphone, Andrea Reid (rhythm guitar), Nick Burfield (lead guitar), Cara Brasted (fiddle), Marz Connelly (double bass), and Mikey Muggeridge (mandolin) are known for their high energy and joyful performances. They are ready to melt your hearts and kick dust up off the floor in a performance that can’t be missed.

Doors 6:30 pm
Music 7-9pm
Tickets $20
Support the artists $30

id: Vote For Dizzy! - The Music Of Dizzy Gillespie-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Vote For Dizzy! - The Music Of Dizzy Gillespie
long_description:
In 1964 Dizzy Gillespie launched his bid to be the next president of the USA. Come join us as we pay tribute to the Jazz Trumpet legend, and ponder what the world could have of been like had he been elected.
With their shared love of the music, the band will play through a selection of Dizzy Gillespie's music in a dynamic performance not to be missed.

Michael Taylor - Trumpet
Oscar Lavën - Sax
Ayrton Foote - Piano
Daniel Yeabsley - Bass
John Rae - Drums

id: Zoe Moon Presents | Blue Moon-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Zoe Moon Presents | Blue Moon
long_description:
Blue Moon was alone. With many dreams in her heart. Without a chance to leave home.

Now she’s free, and ready to roam!

Her first order of business is to bring us an elegant evening of heartwarming music. Showcasing a love of the classics, a touch of future classics and an eclectic assortment of Jazz, Blues, Country, Soul, and anything else that makes her feel good inside. Come get cozy with Zeze and her magic mambo mixture of melodic mellifluousness!

Limited seats available! So get in quick!

Z o E M o o N is an Artist with a wealth of songs bursting from her soul. Hawaiian-born, Aotearoa bred: Legends of this fledgling of a musical dynasty’s spellbinding performances have proven to be true. Fresh off her debut solo release ‘Bubbles’ where we hear Zoe’s voice effortlessly glide from resonant low notes to angelic upper registers, and her Duet ‘Sister’ with her real-life big sister Deva Mahal she’s certainly proven to be one to watch and remember.

For Zoe, music is the very fabric that connects and transcends, music is family. Truth-seeking with a keen ear for harmony, a dynamic stage presence and a depth of feeling that must be seen to be believed, she weaves a world of influences into an undulating dance between strength and softness.

After opening for, and singing on the Grammy award-winning TajMo tour, honing her skills touring the world twice over, Zoe comes to us now crystallized by the world stage. Swirling with the experience of performing on stages like North Sea Jazz Festival, Montreux Jazz Festival, Jools Holland show, and even the Hollywood bowl, she is no stranger to putting on a true performance. You may have even seen her alongside longtime friend and partner in crime Estère, or recognize her from local legendary band Brockaflower.

No longer apologising for who she is, where she’s from or what she has to say, treat yourself to an artist who makes every show a captivating memory to treasure.

$20 online, $25 on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026

id: Album Release | Oscar Lavën 'Flamingovision'-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Album Release | Oscar Lavën 'Flamingovision'
long_description:
His improvisations consistently reveal an immersion in the tradition balanced with a fearless, joyful and searching personality of his own.” - UK Jazz News

After releasing his last album 'Elegant Calamity' to a sold-out crowd at last Wellington Jazz Festival, flamboyant saxophonist Oscar Lavën makes his return to the Rogue and Vagabond this festival to release a brand new album, 'Flamingovision'.

Oscar Lavën has played with many notable artists such as John Beasley's MONKestra, Steve Gadd, James Carter, Dave Weckl, Peter Erskine, Lalah Hathaway, Clay Jenkins and more. His effervescent style draws on an eclectic musical background of early swing music, New Orleans traditional, straight-ahead, spiritual jazz, classical music, blues, and 50s bar-walking rock and roll sax.

Prepare for a colourful, kaleidoscopic performance featuring Duncan Haynes (piano), John Rae (drums), Michael Taylor (trumpet) and Patrick Bleakley (double bass) as they play through the album live in an exciting release of new original New Zealand music.

$15 online, $20 on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026

id: Wallace Sings Music From The Movies-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Wallace Sings Music From The Movies
long_description:
Future soul singer Wallace presents an evening of songs from the movies and musicals that soundtracked her childhood - The Wizard of Oz, Singing in the Rain, Some Like It Hot, Sabrina and more.

From a young age, Wallace was captivated by music from the golden age of Hollywood, singing along to the likes of Judy Garland, Marilyn Monroe and Doris Day. That early love became a gateway into jazz and ultimately set her on her musical path.

After more than a decade living and touring overseas, Wallace is now back home in Wellington. Her international career has seen her tour alongside artists including Sampa the Great, and support heavyweights such as Little Simz, Morcheeba, Jordan Rakei, Rag'n'Bone Man, Slum Village and Masego. Now, with a six-piece band, led by the incredible Daniel Hayles, she returns to the music where it all began.

Wow, what a voice... Just good soul music - Gilles Peterson

$20 online $25 on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026

id: The Racket Lounge-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Racket Lounge
long_description:
Grab a spot on our couch and enjoy the noise at The Racket Lounge - a chill classical music series showcasing up-and-coming Pōneke musicians.

If you’ve never been to a classical concert before, or if you have and now you want to see talented emerging musicians experimenting and playing what they want to play, then The Racket Lounge is for you. Over the past two seasons we’ve seen classical covers, jazz ensembles, video game soundtracks, original compositions, loop pedals, poetry and much more. Our 2026 season is shaping up to be just as epic, plus with your tickets starting at just $5 you can afford to take a chance on something new.

Each concert will feature a different line up of musicians and genres, to be announced a week before each session. If you’re a musician looking to perform at The Racket Lounge, then head to the New Zealand String Quartet’s website to see how to apply.



The Racket Lounge is created and presented by the New Zealand String Quartet Trust - Te Rōpū Tūrū o Aotearoa, New Zealand’s longest-running professional string quartet. With support from Wellington City Council.

Tickets are choose your price starting from just $5.

Please note that Bedlam & Squalor is a licensed venue, so under 18s must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Everyone must bring ID.

id: Chelsea Prastiti Plays Disney With Strings-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Chelsea Prastiti Plays Disney With Strings
long_description:
Since a tender age Chelsea Prastiti has been enchanted by the music and stories of Disney. A childhood of riding horses bareback through the Kaimais and a career of searing RnB, hip hop, and bebop rough-housing might not put one in mind of a Disney princess (Mulan and Pocahontas notwithstanding), but Prastiti has a soft side too, one which she will explore in this extra special festival closer at the Rogue and Vagabond.

Prastiti will perform music from favourites Cinderella, The Little Mermaid, The Jungle Book, and more, backed by a jazz combo augmented by strings, recalling the lush orchestrations of the musical minds behind Disney's classic 20th Century films such as Frank Churchill, Oliver Wallace and Alan Menken

$20 online, $25 on the door


Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026
